content_sections.heading: About Berhampur University P.G. Department of Marine Sciences
content_sections.text: The P.G. Department of Marine Sciences is part of Berhampur University, located at Bhanja Bihar, Berhampur - 760007, Odisha. This post is part of an NRSC/ISRO project funded by ISRO, Department of Space, Govt. of India (sanction letter dated Sep 01, 2022). The Principal Investigator is Dr. Tamoghna Acharyya, an Associate Professor in the department.

content_sections.heading: Berhampur University Senior Research Fellow Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: These fellowship rates depend on specific approval from the funding agency, the availability of sanctioned project funds and the applicable institutional rules. The project is titled "Satellite detection and evaluation of phytoplankton size classes during recurring bloom events in coastal waters of the north-western Bay of Bengal." The SRF will do seasonal water sampling in the Rushikulya Estuary from a country boat or local boat. The role also covers radiometer operation, satellite data analysis, sample analysis, data interpretation and report preparation. FREEJOBALERT DAILY QUIZ Preparing for Govt Exams? content_sections.heading: Berhampur University Senior Research Fellow Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: The upper age limit is 32 years. Reserved and female candidates get age relaxation as per Govt. rules. First-class M.Sc. degree in Marine Sciences, Oceanography, Environmental Sciences, or a closely related discipline from a recognized university. At least two years of relevant research experience after obtaining the qualifying postgraduate degree, supported by documentary evidence. Preference may be given to candidates with demonstrated experience in: Coastal oceanographic field surveys, including water sampling from research vessels or fishing boats. Operation of oceanographic instruments, radiometers and in situ water-quality monitoring equipment. Laboratory analysis of seawater samples, including nutrients, chlorophyll and phytoplankton. Processing and interpretation of satellite ocean-colour data, particularly OCM-3, MODIS, Sentinel-3 or PACE-OCI. Scientific data analysis, interpretation and preparation of technical reports or research publications. For the full eligibility conditions of the post, check the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is through a walk-in interview at the Department of Marine Sciences, Berhampur University, on 16 November 2026 at 11.00 am. Only candidates who have sent their applications by 14 November may attend. Bring the following to the interview: Original degree certificates and mark sheets, with one set of photocopies Passport size colour photos (3 Nos.) Other relevant documents, such as copies of publications (if any), awards and recommendations No TA/DA or other allowance is paid for attending the interview. Canvassing in any form will disqualify the candidate.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The position is purely temporary for 01 year. It is co-terminus with the project and/or lasts as long as funds are available. Selected candidates cannot claim any regular or part-time appointment in this institute or any other institution during this period.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Berhampur University Senior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Prepare your updated resume and a cover letter. Add self-attested copies of your educational qualification certificates, your mark sheets (10th, 12th, B.Sc. and M.Sc.) and any experience certificates. Combine all of these into a single PDF file. Address the application to Dr. Tamoghna Acharyya, P.I., (ISRO) Project, Department of Space, Govt. of India, P.G. Department of Marine Sciences, Berhampur University -760007, Odisha. Email the PDF to [email protected] on or before 14 November 2026. Attend the walk-in interview on 16 November 2026 at 11.00 am with your original documents.

faq.question: Q1. How much is the SRF fellowship at Berhampur University?
faq.answer: Candidates who have qualified NET/GATE or an equivalent get Rs. 41,000 per month plus admissible HRA. Non-NET candidates get Rs. 37,000 per month plus admissible HRA.

faq.question: Q2. Can I attend the interview without emailing an application first?
faq.answer: No. Only candidates who send their application by 14 November can attend the walk-in interview on 16 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. Where and when is the interview?
faq.answer: It is in the Department of Marine Sciences, Berhampur University, Bhanja Bihar, Berhampur, on 16 November 2026 at 11.00 am.

faq.question: Q4. How much research experience do I need?
faq.answer: You need at least two years of relevant research experience after your postgraduate degree, backed by documentary evidence.

faq.question: Q5. What is the maximum age?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 32 years. Reserved and female candidates get relaxation as per Govt. rules.

faq.question: Q6. Which mark sheets go with the application?
faq.answer: Send self-attested copies of your 10th, 12th, B.Sc. and M.Sc. mark sheets. Put them in a single PDF with your resume, cover letter, certificates and any experience certificates.

faq.question: Q7. What will the SRF's work involve?
faq.answer: The work includes seasonal water sampling in the Rushikulya Estuary from a country boat or local boat, radiometer operation, satellite data analysis, sample analysis, data interpretation and report preparation.

faq.question: Q8. How long is the appointment?
faq.answer: It is purely temporary for 01 year and co-terminus with the ISRO project, and/or lasts as long as funds are available.

faq.question: Q9. Is travel allowance paid for the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice says no TA/DA or any other allowance is admissible for attending the interview.

faq.question: Q10. Which satellite data skills are preferred?
faq.answer: Experience in processing and interpreting satellite ocean-colour data is preferred, particularly OCM-3, MODIS, Sentinel-3 or PACE-OCI.
